summary: The fund invests, under normal circumstances, at least 80% of its net assets, plus any borrowings for investment purposes, in constituents of the index and/or investments that have economic characteristics that are substantially similar to the economic characteristics of such constituents. The index is a modified capitalization-weighted index that is comprised of companies incorporated and traded in India that are profitable and that are eligible to be purchased by foreign investors. It is non-diversified.
